questions.question: An organization wants to track Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and other regulated data across its CMDB. Which CSDM artifact is used to model this data?
questions.answer_source: ServiceNow CSDM 3.0 white paper - Information Object is the CMDB table used to describe logical data (such as PII, financial data) associated with Business Applications for compliance and regulatory tracking.
questions.explanation: ServiceNow CSDM 3.0 white paper - Information Object is the CMDB table used to describe logical data (such as PII, financial data) associated with Business Applications for compliance and regulatory tracking.

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator needs to review and modify the field-to-field mappings for a Service Graph Connector (SGC). Which application is used to view and modify these mappings?
questions.answer_source: ServiceNow Community / docs - Service Graph Connectors use the IntegrationHub ETL framework. The IntegrationHub ETL Transform Map Assistant is the editor used to view and modify field mappings (Preview and Prepare Data, Select CMDB Classes to Map Source Data, individual field mappings).
questions.explanation: ServiceNow Community / docs - Service Graph Connectors use the IntegrationHub ETL framework. The IntegrationHub ETL Transform Map Assistant is the editor used to view and modify field mappings (Preview and Prepare Data, Select CMDB Classes to Map Source Data, individual field mappings).

questions.question: What benefits does the CMDB provide to Change Management?

choices.text: Impact insight via affected CIs and service dependencies
Automatic population of the change Assignment Group via CI support/change group

questions.answer_source: ServiceNow Community (Mark Bodman, ServiceNow) - 'How Change Management leverages CSDM': Dynamic CI Groups, impact analysis (Affected CIs unpacking), and Assignment Group routing all leverage the CMDB/CSDM to make Change Management better.
questions.explanation: ServiceNow Community (Mark Bodman, ServiceNow) - 'How Change Management leverages CSDM': Dynamic CI Groups, impact analysis (Affected CIs unpacking), and Assignment Group routing all leverage the CMDB/CSDM to make Change Management better.

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator needs a single place to manage attributes, identification and reconciliation (IRE) rules, and relationships for each CI class. Where can this be done?
questions.answer_source: ServiceNow product documentation - The CI Class Manager is the centralized place to create and edit CI classes including their attributes, IRE (identification and reconciliation) rules, and relationships.
questions.explanation: ServiceNow product documentation - The CI Class Manager is the centralized place to create and edit CI classes including their attributes, IRE (identification and reconciliation) rules, and relationships.

questions.question: What does a CMDB Data Foundations Dashboard remediation playbook offer?

choices.text: Downstream impact insight if the issue is not fixed
Remediation steps and options to resolve the low indicator score
Automatic correction of all health issues

questions.answer_source: ServiceNow Community '5 Steps to Monitor CMDB Health Proactively' - Each playbook has 3 plays (Analysis, Fix, Data Governance) and includes: Executive Summary, Upstream causes, Downstream consequences (what happens if not fixed), and Remediation steps to resolve the low indicator score.
questions.explanation: ServiceNow Community '5 Steps to Monitor CMDB Health Proactively' - Each playbook has 3 plays (Analysis, Fix, Data Governance) and includes: Executive Summary, Upstream causes, Downstream consequences (what happens if not fixed), and Remediation steps to resolve the low indicator score.

questions.question: An organization needs to add a new CI class for a new equipment type entering the environment. What is the recommended approach?

choices.text: Create the class in CI Class Manager, inheriting from the appropriate parent class
Create a new table directly in System Definition without a parent
Add custom attributes to the base Configuration Item [cmdb_ci] table
Use the CMDB Workspace to create a custom CI list

questions.answer_source: ServiceNow product documentation - New CI classes are created in CI Class Manager and should always extend from an appropriate parent class to inherit attributes, identification rules, and relationships from the CMDB class hierarchy.
questions.explanation: ServiceNow product documentation - New CI classes are created in CI Class Manager and should always extend from an appropriate parent class to inherit attributes, identification rules, and relationships from the CMDB class hierarchy.

questions.question: What is the prerequisite for CMDB 360 (Multisource CMDB) to track CI attributes from different data sources?

choices.text: All CI data must be loaded directly via Transform Maps
CI data must be processed through the Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE)
All CIs must be in the Principal Class filter

questions.answer_source: ServiceNow docs - CMDB 360/Multisource CMDB only tracks data populated via the IRE. Data sources that don't go through IRE (e.g. direct table writes) are not captured in CMDB 360. Service Graph Connectors and Discovery use IRE by design.
questions.explanation: ServiceNow docs - CMDB 360/Multisource CMDB only tracks data populated via the IRE. Data sources that don't go through IRE (e.g. direct table writes) are not captured in CMDB 360. Service Graph Connectors and Discovery use IRE by design.

questions.question: What do CMDB Health Playbooks help with?

choices.text: Analyzing the underlying cause of a health issue and providing fix steps
Automatically discovering new CIs in the environment

questions.answer_source: ServiceNow Community / Now Support - CMDB Health 'Get Well' Playbooks contain Analysis Play, Fix Play, and Data Governance Play sections to help admins analyze the underlying issue and apply remediation steps to fix it.
questions.explanation: ServiceNow Community / Now Support - CMDB Health 'Get Well' Playbooks contain Analysis Play, Fix Play, and Data Governance Play sections to help admins analyze the underlying issue and apply remediation steps to fix it.

questions.question: What outcomes does CMDB Governance provide?

choices.text: Enhanced ITSM operations through reliable data
Improved visibility and control over CMDB data quality
Automatic creation of all CI relationships
Elimination of the need for Discovery

questions.answer_source: ServiceNow Community CMDB best practices - Governance provides clear roles/responsibilities, ongoing oversight, accuracy and trust in CMDB data, which enables enhanced ITSM operations and provides visibility/control across the configuration management process.
questions.explanation: ServiceNow Community CMDB best practices - Governance provides clear roles/responsibilities, ongoing oversight, accuracy and trust in CMDB data, which enables enhanced ITSM operations and provides visibility/control across the configuration management process.

questions.question: Using the 'Govern Data' play of a Get Well Playbook, how does an organization prevent Services from being created without an owner?

choices.text: Make the 'Owned by' field mandatory on the Service table
Create a scheduled job to delete services without owners
Restrict Service creation to the admin role only
Disable the Service table in the CMDB

questions.answer_source: ServiceNow docs: the 'Services with Owners' metric checks operational services whose owned_by field is populated. Making 'Owned by' mandatory prevents new services without an owner (the Govern play also recommends standard procedures and periodic certification). Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-foundations-dashboard.html
questions.explanation: ServiceNow docs: the 'Services with Owners' metric checks operational services whose owned_by field is populated. Making 'Owned by' mandatory prevents new services without an owner (the Govern play also recommends standard procedures and periodic certification). Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-foundations-dashboard.html

questions.question: Which CMDB capabilities support Event Management?

choices.text: Binding alerts to specific CIs in the CMDB
Propagating business impact through CI relationships to Application/Business Services
Generating events automatically from CI attribute changes

questions.answer_source: ServiceNow Event Management docs and community - Event Rules bind alerts to CIs in the CMDB using IRE; once bound, Event Management calculates the impact of the alert on the related Application Service / Business Service through the service map relationships.
questions.explanation: ServiceNow Event Management docs and community - Event Rules bind alerts to CIs in the CMDB using IRE; once bound, Event Management calculates the impact of the alert on the related Application Service / Business Service through the service map relationships.

questions.question: After CIs have been retired using a Retire policy, what is the upgrade-safe way to remove them permanently from the CMDB?

choices.text: Manually delete each CI record from the table
Create a CMDB Data Manager Delete policy
Use a Business Rule to bulk delete by status
Drop the table from System Definition

questions.answer_source: ServiceNow docs, CMDB Data Manager - The documented Data Manager life cycle is: retirement definition -> Retire policy -> Delete (or Archive) policy targeting the retired CIs. The docs even use 'delete all containers that haven't been discovered in the past week' as the Delete policy example. Custom scripts, business rules or scheduled jobs are discouraged. (Approval only happens when the policy's 'Needs review' option is set.) Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-management.html
questions.explanation: ServiceNow docs, CMDB Data Manager - The documented Data Manager life cycle is: retirement definition -> Retire policy -> Delete (or Archive) policy targeting the retired CIs. The docs even use 'delete all containers that haven't been discovered in the past week' as the Delete policy example. Custom scripts, business rules or scheduled jobs are discouraged. (Approval only happens when the policy's 'Needs review' option is set.) Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-management.html

questions.question: A CI in the Server [cmdb_ci_server] class is reclassified to the more specific Windows Server [cmdb_ci_win_server] class (parent to child). What type of CI Reclassification is this?
questions.answer_source: ServiceNow CI Reclassification documentation - A Class Upgrade occurs when a CI is moved from a parent class to a more specific child class (e.g., Server → Windows Server). The newly assigned class has additional attributes. The opposite (child → parent) is a Class Downgrade, and across different branches is a Class Switch.
questions.explanation: ServiceNow CI Reclassification documentation - A Class Upgrade occurs when a CI is moved from a parent class to a more specific child class (e.g., Server → Windows Server). The newly assigned class has additional attributes. The opposite (child → parent) is a Class Downgrade, and across different branches is a Class Switch.

questions.question: Which CSDM domain contains Business Capabilities?
questions.answer_source: ServiceNow CSDM whitepaper and CSDM 5 documentation - Business Capabilities, Business Applications, and Information Objects are elements of the Design (Design and Planning) domain. The Design domain represents architecture and rationalization.
questions.explanation: ServiceNow CSDM whitepaper and CSDM 5 documentation - Business Capabilities, Business Applications, and Information Objects are elements of the Design (Design and Planning) domain. The Design domain represents architecture and rationalization.

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator has many similar de-duplication tasks to resolve. How can the Administrator remediate them in bulk?

choices.text: Resolve each task individually using the Duplicate CI Remediator wizard
Create and run a De-Duplication Template
Manually merge each pair of duplicates

questions.answer_source: ServiceNow CMDB Workspace documentation - De-Duplication Templates offer a solution to resolve de-duplication tasks in bulk by applying the same resolution criteria across many similar tasks (as opposed to the Duplicate CI Remediator wizard, which resolves tasks individually).
questions.explanation: ServiceNow CMDB Workspace documentation - De-Duplication Templates offer a solution to resolve de-duplication tasks in bulk by applying the same resolution criteria across many similar tasks (as opposed to the Duplicate CI Remediator wizard, which resolves tasks individually).

questions.question: What methods are available to define CMDB Group membership?

choices.text: Saved queries (CMDB Query Builder queries spanning multiple classes)

questions.answer_source: ServiceNow CMDB Groups documentation - CMDB Groups can be populated three ways: Saved Queries (Query Builder), Encoded Queries (single-class with filter), and manual CI entry. The two dynamic methods are encoded queries and saved queries.
questions.explanation: ServiceNow CMDB Groups documentation - CMDB Groups can be populated three ways: Saved Queries (Query Builder), Encoded Queries (single-class with filter), and manual CI entry. The two dynamic methods are encoded queries and saved queries.

questions.question: Which role is responsible for CI data accuracy and discrepancy resolution in the CMDB?
questions.answer_source: ServiceNow CMDB documentation and SACM role definitions - The Configuration Manager oversees the CMDB and is responsible for maintaining accuracy, completeness, and usefulness of CI data; coordinates with CI owners on discrepancies and exception resolution; and ensures data governance is followed.
questions.explanation: ServiceNow CMDB documentation and SACM role definitions - The Configuration Manager oversees the CMDB and is responsible for maintaining accuracy, completeness, and usefulness of CI data; coordinates with CI owners on discrepancies and exception resolution; and ensures data governance is followed.

questions.question: A Configuration Manager needs a report of CIs that were created from hardware asset records and have never been discovered. Which condition identifies these CIs?

choices.text: Most recent discovery is older than 60 days

questions.explanation: CIs created from assets get the discovery source SNAssetManagement; ServiceNow Discovery sets 'ServiceNow'. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/it-asset-management/asset-management/c_ManagingAssets.html; ServiceNow University KB0012913 (CIS-DF exam blueprint)

questions.question: An Asset Manager changes the State of a hardware asset that is logically mapped to a CI. Which CI fields can the asset-CI synchronization update? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: A change to the asset's state updates the mapped CI's Install Status or Hardware Status and sub status (and vice versa). Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/it-asset-management/asset-management/c_ManagingAssets.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator is explaining a Data Foundations Dashboard remediation playbook to a CIO. Drag each playbook section to its position in the playbook.

items.text: Why it is important to address the issue
How to fix or improve the score

questions.explanation: Each Data Foundations remediation playbook gives a summary of the indicator, an overview of the problem, why it is important to address it, and then how to fix or improve the score. Source: ServiceNow University KB0012913 (CIS-DF exam blueprint); ServiceNow University course 'CMDB Fundamentals' (Australia)

questions.question: Now Assist for CMDB includes an AI agent that resolves duplicate CIs automatically. Which existing CMDB capability does the agent use to remediate the duplicates?
questions.explanation: The CMDB Duplicate CI Agent uses the de-duplication templates framework (plus an assistant skill) to resolve de-duplication tasks automatically. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/now-assist-for-configuration-management-database-cmdb/na-cmdb-agent-dedup-task.html

questions.question: An IP scanning tool keeps inserting server CIs with almost no detail, but its updates to existing servers are still useful. What should the CMDB Administrator configure?

choices.text: An IRE data source rule that blocks inserts from that source for the Server class
A reconciliation rule that gives the source the lowest priority
A data refresh rule for the source
An identification inclusion rule for the Server class

questions.explanation: IRE data source rules prevent a specific discovery source from inserting new CIs for a class while still letting it update them. Reconciliation rules only govern updates, not inserts. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/create-ire-data-source-rule.html

questions.question: Which steps are required to start using CMDB 360/Multisource CMDB on an instance? (Choose two.)

choices.text: Activate the ITOM Discovery License plugin
Install the CMDB CI Class Models store application
Create a dynamic reconciliation rule for every class

questions.explanation: CMDB 360 isn't active by default: enable the multisource_enabled property and activate the ITOM Discovery License (com.snc.itom.discovery.license) plugin. Dynamic reconciliation rules can only be created after that. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/multisource-cmdb.html; ServiceNow University course 'CMDB Fundamentals' (Australia)

questions.question: Which CSDM domain was introduced in CSDM 5 to capture product ideas, goals and strategic planning for new or improved services?
questions.explanation: Ideation & Strategy is new in CSDM 5. It represents ideas, concepts and considerations for new or enhanced services and is part of Strategic Portfolio Management. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/ideation-strategy-domain.html; CSDM 5 white paper (ServiceNow)

questions.question: In CSDM 5 the Application Service table [cmdb_ci_service_auto] was relabeled 'Service Instance'. What was the main reason?

choices.text: To support more kinds of service instances, such as data, network, facility and operational process services
To merge business applications into the service table
To stop using service instances in incident and change

questions.explanation: Organizations were storing many kinds of service data in that table, so CSDM 5 generalized it to Service Instance and added new extensions (data, network, connection, operational process and facility service instances). Application services are still service instances. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/manage-tech-servs-domain.html; ServiceNow University course 'CSDM 5 Fundamentals'

questions.question: Following CSDM 5, which practice is no longer recommended when creating service CIs?

choices.text: Creating CIs directly in the base Service [cmdb_ci_service] class
Using the Business Service and Technology Management Service tables
Tracking services with Life Cycle Stage and Life Cycle Stage Status
Using the Teams related list to manage several group types

questions.explanation: Use the dedicated extended tables - Business Service [cmdb_ci_service_business] and Technology Management Service [cmdb_ci_service_technical] - instead of creating CIs in the generic base service class. Source: ServiceNow University course 'CSDM 5 Fundamentals'

questions.question: Application Portfolio Management (APM), the product that manages Business Applications and Business Capabilities, is now known as which ServiceNow product?
questions.explanation: APM was renamed Enterprise Architecture (EA); CSDM material still sometimes says APM, e.g. 'Foundation for future EA use (formerly APM)' in the Crawl stage. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/application-portfolio-management/application-portfolio-management-landing-page.html; ServiceNow University course 'CSDM 5 Fundamentals'
